title: Structured Windows desktop actuation
objective: Implement structured Windows UI Automation actuation before any coordinate fallback. Invoke, value, selection, toggle, and scroll actions must target exact current UIA elements under exact process/window identities with expected role/state/pattern availability, fresh approval where required, protected-surface denial, and bounded postcondition verification.

include: UIA InvokePattern actuation on exact eligible elements
UIA ValuePattern set_value on bounded non-password editable elements
UIA SelectionItemPattern select, TogglePattern toggle, and ScrollPattern scroll on exact eligible elements

server-issued element identities bound to process instance, window generation, UIA runtime identity/path, role/control type, pattern support, state, workspace/policy revision, and observation generation
immediate pre-execution re-observation and exact expected role/state/pattern verification
fresh approval/effect classification per action with one-shot digest binding and bounded postcondition re-observation

denial of password/credential elements, Quntal/protected/security windows, cross-session elements, focus/activation widening not required by the exact structured action, and arbitrary UIA pattern invocation
tests for element replacement, window/PID reuse, disabled/read-only/state drift, pattern disappearance, focus races, approval replay, human interruption where relevant, and postcondition mismatch

authority_delta.ui_input: Structured UIA invoke/value/select/toggle/scroll becomes live only on exact typed elements; no raw OS input stream is added.
authority_delta.secrets: Password/credential targets remain denied and secret-bearing values are excluded from evidence/logs.
authority_delta.approval: Mutations use explicit effect/approval classes with fresh one-shot binding; no persistent/model/remote approval.
authority_delta.privileged: None; no elevation or secure-desktop reach.

invariants: structured desktop actuation precedes and is strictly preferred over coordinates
every action is exact-element/current-state bound and stale elements fail closed
no generic UIA or raw input primitive is exposed

acceptance.claim: Invoke, set_value, select, toggle, and scroll work on real Windows controls only when exact element/window/process identity, expected state, and required pattern support still match.
Replaced/stale/disabled/read-only/wrong-role/wrong-pattern elements, PID/HWND reuse, approval replay/drift, protected/security surfaces, and postcondition mismatch fail closed.
Password/credential elements cannot be read through value actuation or written, and no secret payload enters evidence/logs.
No coordinate/raw input, arbitrary UIA pattern, elevation, secure desktop, or remote actuation is introduced.
Exact-head real-Windows tests, CI, TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, security review, and zero unresolved blockers pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000082: Coordinate fallback may activate only after structured actuation is live, preferred, and failure-separated.

done_when: Structured Windows UIA actuation is canonically live on exact typed elements with approval/postcondition controls and no raw-input or protected-surface widening.
